testcase.name: Scenario: Open and cancels Create Block from the expanded Create panel: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:122:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and cancels Create Block from the expanded Create panel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/construction/regular-circle-12mm.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the Sketch Create panel's additional command area is open ✔ When the user selects Create Block from that area ✔ Then the Create Block dialog opens over the sketch ✔ And the dialog offers geometry and insert-point selectors ✔ And the block name and description fields are visible ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes without creating a block ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged
